patterns.title: of, and the one that
patterns.say: 的 hangs everything in front of a noun on it: a possessor, an adjective, a whole clause. If the noun is left out, 的 alone stands for it (that one is ours).
patterns.classical: 之 and 者 share the work. 之 joins possessor and noun: 君子之德風 'the gentleman's virtue is wind'. A clause ending 的 is 者: 知之者不如好之者 'those who know it are not equal to those who love it'.

examples.zh: 弹钢琴的女孩是我妹妹。
examples.en: The girl playing the piano is my sister.
His joke was great.
I love my wife.
That house is ours.

patterns.title: it is so, stressing how or where
patterns.shape: subject + 是 + (how / where / when / who) + verb + 的
patterns.say: 是…的 does not tell a new event; it takes a fact as given and says how it is: by what means, from where, on purpose or not. Drop the 是 and 的 and the sentence is bare.

examples.en: I come from China.

examples.zh: 我是用法文写这封信的。
examples.en: I wrote this letter in French.
I didn't do it on purpose.
Money is not everything.

patterns.title: done, carried out
patterns.say: 了 straight after a verb marks the action as done or carried out. It usually comes with a counted object or a length of time, since a bare 了 would leave the sentence unfinished.

examples.zh: 我在咖啡店里喝了一杯咖啡。
examples.en: I had a cup of coffee at the coffee shop.
I dreamed a strange dream.

examples.zh: 他给我写了一封很长的信。
examples.en: He wrote me a long letter.
I read the novel in three days.

patterns.title: now it is so
patterns.say: A final 了 says a situation has newly come about: it is now this way, or no longer that way. It reports a change, not a finished verb.
patterns.classical: 矣, close for this sense: 甚矣吾衰也 'how far gone I am'.

examples.en: I think I'm lost.
I think the wind's dropping off.
This man is drunk.

examples.zh: 我今天没有时间去那里了。
examples.en: I don't have time to go there today.

patterns.title: not, will not
patterns.say: 不 negates what is, what someone wants, what is habitual, or what is yet to come. It is the plain no, with no reference to whether something happened.
patterns.classical: The same word, same job: 人不知而不慍 'others do not know him, and he is not resentful'.

examples.en: I don't want to hurt you.
My brother won't be at home tomorrow.
I don't understand German at all.

patterns.title: has not, none
patterns.say: 没 negates having and doing. 没 + verb says the thing did not happen; 没 + noun says there is none of it.
patterns.classical: 未 for 'has not yet' (吾未見好德如好色者也), 無 for 'have none'.

examples.en: I haven't seen a doctor.

examples.zh: 我想要一辆车，但我没钱买。
examples.en: I want a car, but I have no money to buy one.

examples.zh: 我们已经十多年没见过他了。
examples.en: We haven't seen him for over ten years.

patterns.title: X is Y
patterns.say: 是 joins two nouns: this is that, or this belongs to that group. It is not used before an adjective (他是高 is wrong; 他很高).
patterns.classical: The old 是 meant 'this' (是魯孔丘與? 'is this Kong Qiu of Lu?'). Classical joined two nouns with 也 at the end: X Y也.

examples.en: French is my mother tongue.

examples.zh: 今天是我们最后一天放假。
examples.en: Today is our last day of vacation.
The greater part of the guests were foreigners.
He is a lover of sports.

patterns.title: have, there is
patterns.shape: 有 + thing / place + 有 + thing
patterns.say: 有 means possess and also 'there is', so 有人 is 'someone'. Its negative is 没有, never 不有.
patterns.classical: The same 有, and 無 for 没有: 有朋自遠方來 'a friend comes from far away'; 無友不如己者 'have no friend who is not as good as yourself'.

examples.zh: 她有一个儿子和两个女儿。
examples.en: She has a son and two daughters.
Someone's going to hurt us.
Nobody is perfect.

examples.zh: 我们一周有五节英语课。
examples.en: We have five English classes a week.

patterns.title: be at, doing it at
patterns.say: 在 names where someone is, or where an action takes place. The place phrase goes before the verb.
patterns.classical: 在 is the same word: 父母在，不遠遊 'while parents are alive, do not travel far'.

examples.zh: 明天下午我在我爸爸的书店。
examples.en: I'll be at my dad's bookstore tomorrow afternoon.
I'm eating soup in the kitchen.
Study in the library.

patterns.title: also, either
patterns.say: 也 adds one more subject to what was just said. After 不 or 没 it means 'either': 我也不.
patterns.classical: Not the old 也. This 也 is 亦: 不亦說乎 'is it not a joy'. The sentence-final 也 of the Analects has no counterpart here.

examples.en: I really want to learn French, too.
I don't like her either.
It's good now; neither too heavy nor too light.

patterns.title: all, both
patterns.say: 都 sums up the thing named before it: all of them, both, every one. It must come after the group it counts.
patterns.classical: 皆: 四海之內皆兄弟也 'within the four seas all are brothers'.

examples.en: All three of us are students.
All of the books are mine.
Both of my parents are lawyers.
We all miss you very much.

patterns.title: yes-or-no question
patterns.say: 吗 at the end makes a statement ask whether it is true. The answer repeats the verb or says no (会, 不会).
patterns.classical: 乎 and 與: 是魯孔丘與? 'Is this Kong Qiu of Lu?'.

examples.en: Can you speak Mandarin?
Do you want to see the house?
Are you already home?

patterns.title: and what about, going on
patterns.say: 呢 softens a question that already has a question word, or asks 'and you?' after a noun. It also closes a statement that insists or says something is under way.

examples.en: Where are you from?

examples.zh: 请问可以在哪里买到票呢？
examples.en: Where can I buy a ticket?
I thought I was dreaming.

patterns.title: suggestion, expectation
patterns.say: 吧 turns a statement into a proposal (let's, do it) or into a question that expects yes (you're his friend, aren't you?).

examples.zh: 明天九点打电话给我吧。
examples.en: Call me at 9:00 tomorrow.
He's your friend, isn't he?
You were hurt, weren't you?
You'd better see a doctor.

patterns.title: counters between number and noun
patterns.say: Between a number or 这/那 and its noun stands a counter that depends on the kind of thing: 本 for books, 条 for long things, 个 for people and the general case. The counter also tells you what kind of noun you are about to meet.

examples.en: The book is easy.
This fish is delicious.
I want to ask you a question.
This boy is my son.

patterns.title: state that goes on
patterns.say: 着 after a verb says the state that verb leaves behind is still there: sitting, open, carrying. It describes a scene, not an event.

examples.en: I left the window open all through the night.

examples.zh: 汤姆还在等候室里坐着。
examples.en: Tom is still sitting in the waiting room.

examples.zh: 汤姆无论到哪里都带着照相机。
examples.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.

examples.zh: 以前这里住着个可怕的怪物。
examples.en: There used to live a scary monster.

patterns.title: has done it before
patterns.say: 过 after a verb says the thing has been done at least once in life, as experience. It is not about the last few minutes.
patterns.classical: 嘗: 吾嘗終日不食 'I once went a whole day without eating'.

examples.en: Have you ever been to Shanghai?
He has not been to France.

examples.zh: 他是我见过的最高的男人了。
examples.en: He is the tallest man that I have ever seen.

patterns.title: in the midst of
patterns.say: 正在, 在 or a final 呢 says an action is in progress at this moment. Any of the three alone is enough.

examples.en: My wife is cooking right now.
I'm watching TV now.
The baby is sleeping.
This road is under repair.

patterns.title: how well it is done
patterns.say: 得 after a verb opens a comment on how the action went: fast, well, badly. If the verb has an object, the verb is said twice: 打网球打得很好.

examples.en: That dog runs very fast.
He was very good at playing tennis.
Her new book is selling well.
Tom is a fluent speaker of Japanese.

patterns.title: in such a manner
patterns.say: 地 turns what comes before it into a manner word and attaches it to the verb that follows.
patterns.classical: 然: 夫子喟然歎曰 'the Master sighed and said'.

examples.en: The little girl laughed a merry laugh.
She worked hard.
Tom looked at Mary suspiciously.
Time has passed very fast.

patterns.title: did it and it worked
patterns.shape: verb + 见 / 到 / 完 / 懂 / 好
patterns.say: A second character right after the verb tells you whether the action reached its goal: 看 is look and 看见 is see; 找 is search and 找到 is find.

examples.en: I heard the door close.
We've got to find the key.

examples.zh: 我看见远处有一间小屋。
examples.en: I saw a cottage in the distance.
Where did you see her?

patterns.title: toward or away
patterns.shape: verb + 来 / 去 / 上 / 下 / 进 / 出 / 回 / 过
patterns.say: 来 and 去 after a verb give the direction of motion: toward the speaker (来) or away (去). A second character can add the route: 进, 出, 回, 过.

examples.en: He'll come on foot or by bicycle.

examples.zh: 我会等在这儿直到他回来。
examples.en: I'll wait here till he comes back.
Winter is gone.

patterns.title: can or cannot
patterns.say: Put 得 or 不 between the verb and its result to say whether it is possible: 看得见 can see, 看不见 cannot. The negative form is the common one.

examples.en: He knows how to read Chinese.

examples.zh: 我听得见你，但我看不见你。
examples.en: I can hear you, but I can't see you.
I could not afford to buy a bicycle.

examples.zh: 这人讲的我完全听不懂。
examples.en: What he said was over my head.

patterns.title: handling a thing
patterns.say: 把 lifts the object in front of the verb so the verb can say what happens to it: moved, put, given. The verb never stands bare after it.
patterns.classical: 以 and 將 do the same in old prose: 以羊易之 'swap it for the sheep' (Mencius).

examples.en: Drop me off at the front door, please.

examples.zh: 现在，我把钥匙放哪里了？
examples.en: Now where did I put the key?
I'll bring it to you tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我想要你把真相告诉我。
examples.en: I want you to tell me the truth.

patterns.title: something done to the subject
patterns.say: 被 marks the subject as the one affected: stolen, moved, interrupted. The doer, if named, comes right after 被.
patterns.classical: 見 before a verb ('be done to') and 為…所 ('by …'); word counterparts only.

examples.en: She had her handbag stolen.

examples.zh: 我的啤酒被我的同屋喝完了。
examples.en: My beer was finished off by my room-mate.

examples.zh: 所有的客人都被她的好客感动了。
examples.en: All the guests were touched by her hospitality.
Someone stole my passport.

patterns.title: more than
patterns.say: 比 makes B the standard: A is taller than B. A degree word may follow the adjective (高很多, 更高).
patterns.classical: 於 after an adjective: 季氏富於周公 'the Ji family was richer than the Duke of Zhou'.

examples.en: He is taller than his brother.
The earth is smaller than the sun.
He is able to run faster than I am.
That woman is much older than I am.

patterns.title: give, for someone
patterns.shape: 给 + person + thing / 给 + person + verb
patterns.say: 给 as a verb is 'give'. Before another verb it means for someone's benefit, or toward a recipient.
patterns.classical: 與: 與之粟九百 'gave him nine hundred measures of grain'.

examples.en: Give me a glass of water, please.
Dad bought a book for me.

examples.zh: 妈妈正在做生日蛋糕给我。
examples.en: My mother is making me a birthday cake.

examples.zh: 汤姆在给他最好的朋友写信。
examples.en: Tom is writing a letter to his best friend.

patterns.title: toward, about
patterns.shape: 对 + person / thing + verb or adjective
patterns.say: 对 names the one a feeling or action is aimed at. 对…来说 is 'as far as … is concerned'.

examples.en: I am interested in movies.
Tom has always been very nice to me.

examples.zh: 这双鞋对我来说太大了。
examples.en: These shoes are too big for me.

examples.zh: 这些汉字对我们来说不太难。
examples.en: These Chinese characters are not too difficult for us.

patterns.title: with, to
patterns.say: 跟 introduces the other party: do it with, talk to, be the same as. 跟…一起 is 'together with'.
patterns.classical: 與: 吾與回言終日 'I talked with Hui all day'.

examples.en: Are you talking to me?

examples.zh: 我要汤姆跟我一起去澳洲。
examples.en: I wanted Tom to go to Australia with me.

examples.zh: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。
examples.en: He put the key on the desk as usual.

examples.zh: 我再也不会跟你说话了。
examples.en: I'll never speak to you again.

patterns.title: from, starting at
patterns.say: 从 gives the point something begins at, in place or time. 从…到… marks the range, and 从…开始 'starting from'.
patterns.classical: 自: 有朋自遠方來 'a friend comes from afar'.

examples.en: Let's start with Lesson Ten.
From here we see the city.

examples.zh: 从现在起，我再也不吃肉了。
examples.en: From now on, I will not eat meat anymore.

examples.zh: 汤姆从上周一到现在都没来这里。
examples.en: Tom hasn't been here since Monday.

patterns.title: arrive, up to
patterns.shape: verb + 到 + place / 到 + place
patterns.say: 到 is 'reach', and after a motion verb it names the place reached. Before a time or place it means 'up to'.
patterns.classical: 至, as a word: 不知老之將至 'not aware that old age is arriving'.

examples.en: Welcome to France!
I'll be flying to Boston.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上六点钟我们来到了这里。
examples.en: We arrived here at six yesterday evening.
I've gone back to the past.

patterns.title: toward
patterns.say: Both mark the direction of a movement or look, and 向 also marks the person an action is directed at (借钱 from someone). Neither describes a source, which is 从.

examples.en: We headed for the mountain cottage.
Don't look into my room.
I can't go any farther.

examples.zh: 我是不会向那些人借钱的。
examples.en: I will not borrow money from those people.

patterns.title: can, will, may
patterns.shape: 会 / 能 / 可以 + verb
patterns.say: 会 is can through learning, or will happen; 能 is can through ability or circumstance; 可以 is may. A negated 不能 often means it is not allowed.
patterns.classical: 能 is the same word (未能事人，焉能事鬼 'cannot yet serve men, how serve spirits'); 可以 too (可以為師矣 'such a one can be a teacher').

examples.en: I speak Arabic.
I'll be busy tomorrow.

examples.zh: 金钱不能买到所有的东西。
examples.en: Money can't buy everything.
You can park here.

patterns.title: should and must
patterns.say: 应该 is should, 必须 is must; 不用 or 不必 says it is not necessary. 必须 has no 'must not': that is 不能 or 别.
patterns.classical: 必 is the same word: 必也正名乎 'it must be the names that are put right'.

examples.en: You should smoke less.
You should bring your passport to the bank.

examples.zh: 你必须为自己的行为负责。
examples.en: You must account for your conduct.

examples.zh: 做任何事，你必须要做到最好。
examples.en: In doing anything, you must do your best.

patterns.title: want, will, be willing
patterns.shape: 想 / 要 / 愿意 + verb
patterns.say: 想 is to think or want to; 要 is to want and also 'will' or 'must'; 愿意 is to be willing. 不想 declines, 不要 means don't.
patterns.classical: 欲 for 想 and 要: 己欲立而立人 'wanting to stand himself, he stands others up'.

examples.en: I want to be a pilot in the future.

examples.zh: 我想要有我自己的房间。
examples.en: I want to have my own room.
I'm going to tell you the truth.
I'm glad to help.

patterns.title: right then, already
patterns.say: 就 ties an event closely to what comes before: it came soon, it follows at once, or it is already so. In a conditional it opens the result clause.
patterns.classical: 則 opens a result: 行有餘力，則以學文 'if there is strength left over, then use it on writing'.

examples.zh: 她十八岁就大学毕业了。
examples.en: She was only 18 when she graduated from university.
I'll be back in a jiffy.

examples.zh: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。
examples.en: I read the book after I had finished my homework.
I was right behind you.

patterns.title: only then, not until
patterns.say: 才 is the opposite of 就: it came late, took trouble, or needed a condition first. 不…才… is 'only if'.

examples.zh: 我通常星期天要到中午才起床。
examples.en: I usually don't get up until noon on Sundays.

examples.zh: 努力工作才能养活自己。
examples.en: Work hard so that you may earn your living.

examples.zh: 你得了解俄语才能学这门语言。
examples.en: You have to know Russian to learn this language.

patterns.title: still, in addition
patterns.say: 还 says the state continues, or something is added on top. 还没 is 'not yet'.
patterns.classical: 猶 and 尚 for 'still' (word only).

examples.en: Crap, I didn't do the homework!
What if Tom is still alive?
Is there anything else you want from me?

patterns.title: again
patterns.shape: 又 + verb (done) / 再 + verb (to be done)
patterns.say: 又 says it has happened again, or joins two qualities as in 又…又…. 再 is again for something still to come.
patterns.classical: 又 is the same word. 再 in the Analects counts two: 再，斯可矣 'twice, and that will do'.

examples.en: His house was small and old.
I've missed another chance.
Tell me again.
You don't need to worry about me anymore.

patterns.title: about to
patterns.shape: 要 / 就要 / 快要 + verb + 了
patterns.say: 要 before the verb and 了 at the end together say that something is about to happen.
patterns.classical: 將: 不知老之將至 'does not know that old age is about to arrive'.

examples.en: I'm going to the bank.
We'll be there soon.
It looks as if it is going to rain.

examples.zh: 我很累，我想我要去睡觉了。
examples.en: I'm tired; I think I'm going to go to bed.

patterns.title: because, so
patterns.say: 因为 gives the reason and 所以 the consequence; either may stand alone. 所以 at the head of a sentence is a plain 'so'.
patterns.classical: 故: 求也退，故進之 'Qiu holds back, therefore I urge him on'.

examples.zh: 因为她生病了，所以她没去学校。
examples.en: She got sick, so she didn't go to school.

examples.zh: 因为他是个友好的人，所以大家都喜欢他。
examples.en: People like him because he is kind.

examples.zh: 因为我们没买到票，所以我们没去音乐会。
examples.en: We weren't able to buy tickets, so we didn't go to the concert.

examples.zh: 因为你工作得太多，所以你总是很累。
examples.en: Because you work so much, you are always very tired.

patterns.title: although, yet
patterns.shape: 虽然 + A，但是 / 可是 / 还是 + B
patterns.say: 虽然 or 尽管 gives a fact that you might expect to block the main point, and the second clause says it does not. The turn word is almost always present.
patterns.classical: 雖: 雖小道，必有可觀者焉 'even a small way surely has something worth seeing'.

examples.zh: 虽然他很有钱，但他不幸福。
examples.en: He's rich, but he isn't happy.

examples.zh: 他虽然年轻，但是位好医生。
examples.en: Young as he is, he is a good doctor.

examples.zh: 虽然外面风很大，但是我们还是会出去散步。
examples.en: It's very windy outside, but we'll still go out for a walk.

examples.zh: 尽管下着雨，我还是出了门。
examples.en: I went out in spite of the rain.

patterns.title: if, then
patterns.shape: 如果 / 要是 + A，(就) + B
patterns.say: 如果 opens a condition and 就 opens the result, where 就 is often the only mark of the second half.
patterns.classical: 如 or 若 for 如果: 如有王者，必世而後仁 'if a true king arose, it would take a generation to make people humane'.

examples.en: I will go if the rain stops.

examples.zh: 你如果需要帮助，就告诉我。
examples.en: If you should need any help, just let me know.

examples.zh: 如果有一天你走了，我会很难过的。
examples.en: If one day you leave, I will be very sad.

patterns.title: if that is so
patterns.say: 的话 closes an if-clause, with or without 如果 to open it. It marks where the condition ends and the main clause begins.

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨的话，我们就不去。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

examples.zh: 不下雨的话，我们出去吧。
examples.en: If it doesn't rain, let's go out.

examples.zh: 可以的话你也一起来吧。
examples.en: Come along with us if you like.

examples.zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。
examples.en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.

patterns.title: not only, but also
patterns.shape: 不但 / 不仅 + A，而且 / 还 + B
patterns.say: The second clause adds to the first and outweighs it. 还 can take the place of 而且.

examples.en: She is as clever as she is beautiful.

examples.zh: 他不但会说普通话，而且会说上海话。
examples.en: Not only can he speak Mandarin, but Shanghainese as well.

examples.zh: 他不但喜欢棒球，还喜欢足球。
examples.en: He likes not only baseball but football as well.

examples.zh: 我们老师不仅说英语，还说法语。
examples.en: Our teacher doesn't just speak English, but French too.

patterns.title: the more, the more
patterns.shape: 越 + A + 越 + B / 越来越 + adjective
patterns.say: Two things grow together: the more of the first, the more of the second. 越来越 alone is 'more and more'.
patterns.classical: 彌: 仰之彌高，鑽之彌堅 'the more I look up, the higher; the more I drill, the harder'.

examples.zh: 你看的书越多，你知道的越多。
examples.en: The more books you read, the more you'll know.

examples.zh: 你知道的越少越好，好吗？
examples.en: The less you know, the better, OK?
It's getting hotter and hotter.
You're really getting prettier and prettier.

patterns.title: even
patterns.shape: 连 + extreme case + 都 / 也 + verb
patterns.say: 连 names an extreme case that sets the point: if even this is so, the rest follows. 都 or 也 follows, usually with a negative or an ability word.

examples.en: Even a child can read this.

examples.zh: 汤姆太老实了，连撒谎都不会。
examples.en: Tom is too honest a boy to tell a lie.

examples.zh: 我的妻子看起来连自己的孩子也不太喜欢。
examples.en: My wife doesn't seem to like even her own children.

examples.zh: 宝宝连走都不会，更何况是跑。
examples.en: The baby can't walk, much less run.

patterns.title: as soon as
patterns.say: One thing happens and the next follows at once. Here 一 means 'as soon as', not the number one.

examples.zh: 小偷一看到警车就跑走了。
examples.en: The thief ran off as soon as he saw the police car.

examples.zh: 他一到伦敦就给我发了电报。
examples.en: On his arrival in London, he sent me a telegram.

examples.zh: 我一喝了酒就立刻变得通红。
examples.en: The minute I have something to drink, I turn bright red.

patterns.title: except, besides
patterns.shape: 除了 + X (以外)，others / 还 + more
patterns.say: Which of the two meanings applies depends on the second half: 都 means 'everyone except X', while 还 or 也 means 'X and also more'.

examples.zh: 除了星期天我每一天都工作。
examples.en: I work every day except Sunday.

examples.zh: 除了我以外，大家都很忙。
examples.en: Everybody is busy except me.

examples.zh: 除了汤姆和玛丽，房间里没有人。
examples.en: There was no one in the room besides Tom and Mary.

examples.zh: 除了英语，他还会说法语。
examples.en: In addition to English, he can speak French.

patterns.title: if only, only if
patterns.shape: 只要 + condition，就 + result / 只有 + condition，才 + result
patterns.say: 只要 gives a sufficient condition: this is all it takes. 只有 gives the only condition: nothing else will do.
patterns.classical: 唯 for 只有: 唯上知與下愚不移 'only the very wise and the very stupid do not change'.

examples.zh: 只要他写作业，他就能玩游戏了。
examples.en: He can play computer games as long as he does his homework.
All you have to do is say the word, and I'll leave.

examples.zh: 只有你好好学习才可以考得上大学。
examples.en: Only if you study hard will you be able to get into university.

examples.zh: 只有你来了，她才会来我的生日派对。
examples.en: Only if you come will she come to my birthday party.

patterns.title: make, let, have
patterns.shape: A + 让 / 叫 / 使 + B + verb
patterns.say: A causes or permits B to do something, and B stays in front of its own verb. 让 and 叫 are everyday; 使 sounds written.
patterns.classical: 使: 民可使由之，不可使知之 'the people can be made to follow it, but not made to understand it'.

examples.zh: 你想让我买多少个苹果？
examples.en: How many apples do you want me to buy?
This medicine will make you feel better.

examples.zh: 妈妈每天叫我起床上学。
examples.en: Mom wakes me up for school every day.

examples.zh: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。
examples.en: You remind me of a boy I used to know.

patterns.title: the word stays in place
patterns.shape: subject + 是 + 谁 / 在 + 哪 / 哪 + counter + noun
patterns.say: A question word sits where the answer would sit; the word order does not change. A yes/no 吗 is not added.
patterns.classical: 誰 is the same word: 夫執輿者為誰 'who is that driving the carriage?'.

examples.en: Whose room is this?
Where are we meeting?
Which stop are you getting off at?
Who is that woman?

patterns.title: anyone, anywhere
patterns.shape: question word + 都 / 也 + verb
patterns.say: Place 都 or 也 after a question word and it stops asking: 谁都 is everyone, anyone, and with 不 no one at all. Here 都 covers the whole range the question word could take.

examples.en: Anyone can join.
We're not scared of anybody.
I'll follow you anywhere.
I drive everywhere.

patterns.title: doubled verbs
patterns.say: A doubled verb is lighter and shorter: try it, take a look, a quick go. It is used for requests and plans, not for things already done.

examples.en: Show me where it hurts.
Let me try another one.

examples.zh: 小孩子们到公园去玩玩。
examples.en: The children went to play in the park.

examples.zh: 让我们来问问这是不是真的。
examples.en: Let's ask if it's true.

patterns.title: don't
patterns.say: 别 forbids or warns. 不要 means the same, and 千万别 is a firm don't.
patterns.classical: 勿 and 毋: 非禮勿視 'do not look at what is not proper'.

examples.en: Stay out of my kitchen.
It's nothing, don't be afraid!
Don't forget to take a camera with you.
Please don't misunderstand me.

patterns.title: in order to
patterns.say: 为了 names the goal that explains the action; the main clause follows.
patterns.classical: 為 is the same word: 古之學者為己，今之學者為人 'the learners of old studied for themselves, those of today for others'.

examples.zh: 为了买这本书，我去了东京。
examples.en: I went to Tokyo to buy this book.

examples.zh: 为了解决问题，他们尽了很大努力。
examples.en: They made a great effort to settle the problem.
We eat so we can live.

patterns.title: of, one of
patterns.shape: A 之 B / the best + noun + 之一
patterns.say: In written Chinese 之 still links two nouns, as 的 would. The set phrase 之一 means 'one of', and 百分之 gives per cent.
patterns.classical: The same 之: 君子之德風 'the gentleman's virtue is wind'.

examples.zh: 这是我吃过的最好的餐馆之一。
examples.en: This is one of the best restaurants that I've ever eaten in.

examples.zh: 那辆车是三辆之中最漂亮的。
examples.en: That car is the most beautiful of the three.
There is no treasure more precious than a child.

examples.zh: 在我看来，澳洲是世界上最好的国家之一。
examples.en: From my point of view, Australia is one of the best countries in the world.

patterns.title: what is done
patterns.say: 所 before a verb forms a noun that means the thing acted on: what is said, what I know. 据我所知 is 'as far as I know'.
patterns.classical: 己所不欲，勿施於人 'what you do not want, do not do to others'.

examples.en: That's exactly what he said.
What Tom did was extremely dangerous.
We do the best we can.

examples.zh: 据我所知，这本书还没被翻译成日语。
examples.en: As far as I know, this book has never been translated into Japanese.

patterns.title: and, but
patterns.shape: A 而 B / 不是 A 而是 B / 而不是 B
patterns.say: 而 joins two clauses or verbs and may mean and, but, or 'and yet'. 不是…而是… is 'not A but B'.
patterns.classical: 而: 君子和而不同 'the gentleman is harmonious but not conforming'; 人不知而不慍.

examples.en: It's not you that she loves, it's me.

examples.zh: 我是日本人，而你是美国人。
examples.en: I am Japanese, but you are an American.

examples.zh: 我决定去美国，而不是欧洲。
examples.en: Instead of going to Europe, I decided to go to America.

examples.zh: 约翰一整天待在床上而没去工作。
examples.en: John stayed in bed all day instead of going to work.

patterns.title: his, its, other
patterns.shape: 其 + 他 / 实 / 中 / 它
patterns.say: 其 alone stands for his, her or its, and in 其他 'others', 其中 'among them', 其实 'in fact' it is part of a word.
patterns.classical: 其 is the same: 其為人也孝弟 'as a person he is filial and respectful'.

examples.en: She was more beautiful than all the others.

examples.zh: 他们都说我的口音像北方人，但我其实是南方人。
examples.en: They all say I sound like someone from the north, but I'm actually from the south.
I'd like to buy one of these.

examples.zh: 如果你有其他问题，请通过表格发给我。
examples.en: If you have any other issues, please notify me through the form.

patterns.title: at, in, than
patterns.say: 于 survives inside words: 关于 about, 等于 equals, 有利于 good for, 终于 at last, 过于 too much. When you meet it, read it as 'at / in / toward'.
patterns.classical: 於 became 于: 吾十有五而志於學 'at fifteen I set my mind on learning'.

examples.en: Exercise is good for your health.
Subtract two from ten and you have eight.

examples.zh: 他们在问关于汤姆的事。
examples.en: They were asking questions about Tom.
At last, it began to rain.

patterns.title: with, so as to
patterns.say: 以 survives as 'with, by means of' and as 'so as to', as in 以免 and 难以. It is rarely used alone in speech.
patterns.classical: 以 is the same: 以直報怨 'repay resentment with uprightness'.

examples.en: I ran as fast as possible to catch up with her.

examples.zh: 我们小声谈话以免被人听到。
examples.en: We talked in a low voice so as not to be heard.
I don't understand him sometimes.
Will this year be different?

patterns.title: or
patterns.shape: A 或者 B / A 还是 B？
patterns.say: 或者 says 'either' in a statement. 还是 is 'or' in a question that asks which one.
patterns.classical: 抑: 求之與？抑與之與？ 'did he seek it, or was it given him?'.

examples.zh: 我们喝葡萄酒或者啤酒吧。
examples.en: Let's drink wine or beer.

examples.zh: 我或者去看电影，或者去看歌剧。
examples.en: I am either going to see a film, or going to see an opera.

examples.zh: 去读大学还是去上班，我还没决定。
examples.en: I haven't decided whether to study at university or to get a job.

examples.zh: 你和爸爸更亲还是妈妈更亲？
examples.en: Are you closer to your mother or to your father?

patterns.title: just like
patterns.shape: A + 像 + B + 一样 (+ adjective)
patterns.say: A resembles B. A word after 一样 says in what way: 像你一样高 is as tall as you.
patterns.classical: 如: 譬如北辰，居其所而眾星共之 'like the polestar that stays in place while the stars turn about it'.

examples.en: He is as happy as a king.

examples.zh: 我希望我有一个像你一样的朋友。
examples.en: I wish I had a friend like you.
It's like a war zone there.

examples.zh: 汤姆像往常一样来晚了。
examples.en: Tom is late as usual.

patterns.title: begin, look, sound
patterns.shape: verb + 起来 / 看起来 / 听起来
patterns.say: 起来 after a verb says the action begins. After 看, 听 or an adjective, it says how a thing looks or sounds on first impression.

examples.en: That sounds like a fairly good proposal.
You seem to be an honest man.
It is expensive running this car.

examples.zh: 不要担心，都会好起来的。
examples.en: Don't worry, it will come out all right.

patterns.title: keep on
patterns.say: 下去 after a verb says the action keeps going from this point on. It looks ahead, where 过 looks back.

examples.en: I'll keep doing it.

examples.zh: 我真的不应该再呆下去了。
examples.en: I really shouldn't stay any longer.
I will live.
This is never going to end.
